items.title: Spending $800 to see my family this Thanksgiving is a financial burden. How can I push for a cheaper flight?
items.description: “My sister always chooses places where it’s cheapest for her to fly.”

items.title: The U.S. and China agree to $60 billion in tariff cuts on products like dolls and fireworks. Rare earths remain a sticking point.
items.description: There were no major breakthroughs on big issues including AI, Iran and Taiwan.

items.title: ‘I’m never selling’: I’m 47 and buy bitcoin with every dollar I earn. Am I crazy?
items.description: “When my paycheck lands, it takes a detour through bitcoin.”

items.title: SpaceX sends its Starship rocket to orbit for the first time — but not without some hiccups
items.description: SpaceX cut the flight short after initially aiming to send it on a nearly 10-hour mission.

items.title: ‘I’d rather be on a beach in Bali’: My husband resents my $8 million net worth. Should I pay for his retirement?
MongoDB’s stock is down nearly 20% as CEO decamps to Meta
items.description: Meta is creating an enterprise platform business that aims to make it easier for developers to use its products. CJ Desai, formerly of MongoDB, will head up the initiative.

items.title: Micron has a chance to set the record straight with its earnings report
items.description: Micron is no longer the company it was before the AI boom, and one analyst says it’s time that investors fully appreciate that.

items.title: Nvidia is right: Its stock is a bargain by this measure
items.description: Nvidia’s stock has gotten cheaper even as the company has sustained robust levels of growth.

items.title: These Gen Z-ers are choosing ETFs over sports bets. How younger investors told us they’re building wealth.
items.description: Gen Z is entering the market unusually young, with easier access to investing than previous generations but vastly different amounts of money to put to work.

items.title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
items.description: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”
